name: Lictor-class dungeon ship
description: The Lictor-class dungeon ship, also known as an Imperial dungeon ship or Mandalorian Dungeon Ship, was a versatile warship and mobile prison based on a design used by the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders during the Mandalorian Wars. The design proved resilient enough that it was still in use nearly four thousand years after its conception.

data.name: Lictor-class dungeon ship
data.navigation: Limited to two consecutive hyperspace jumps
